name: Delton Cables Limited
about: Delton Cables Limited manufactures and supplies wires, cables, and switchgears in India and internationally. The company offers wires and cables, such as power and control, instrumentation, building, single/multi flexible, medium voltage, railway signaling, rubber, telephone, aerial self-supporting telephone, jelly filled telephone, solar AC/DC, coaxial, steel braided, welding, thermocouple and compensating, special, and ABC cables, as well as drop wire and submersible flat and round cables. It also provides structures cabling solutions, including keystone, patch cord and panel, surface mount box, solid cable, and face plates and speaker cables; fiber networking solutions, consisting of single mode cable, fiber patch cord, and LIU; and fiber cable solutions, such as fire alarm and survival cable. In addition, the company is involved in trading activities. It serves power and mining, telecommunication, railways, aerospace, transportation, energy, premise infrastructure, oil and gas, cement and steel, and water treatment plant industries. Delton Cables Limited was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Faridabad, India.
